verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no quickstart guide, install walkthrough, or time-to-first-skill claim. The only install-related items are a contributor dev-mode symlink (CONTRIBUTING.md), an upgrade skill that detects global versus vendored installs, and a community mention of a git-clone-and-copy install model. None of these documents an onboarding path that gets a new developer to a working installed skill in under five minutes.

support.subject: As a developer, a quickstart takes me from nothing to a working installed skill in under five minutes
